The '''Ianane system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located amidst the [[Hyperspace anomaly/Legends|hyperspace anomalies]] west of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained at least three [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Ianane III]], whose brightness led to it being mistaken for a stellar companion for its [[Star/Legends|star]]. It was also the site of the [[Ianane Ring]], an ring-shaped object as black as Ianane III was white.
